alerts.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued October 19 at 9:55PM PDT until October 20 at 11:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents and breaking waves. Surf of 3 to 6
feet with local sets as high as 7 feet. Highest surf on south
and southwest facing beaches.

* WHERE...San Diego County coastal areas and Orange County
coastal areas.

* WHEN...Through Tuesday evening.

* IMPACTS...Areas of hazardous swimming conditions. Rip currents
can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea. Waves can wash
people off beaches and rocks, and capsize small boats
nearshore.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Minor beach erosion may occur across
south- facing beaches.
